text:
Maya: Quick sync - we need a compact pilot scope policy to include in DP invites. aim: clear expectations, fast decisions, minimal churn.
Ravi: Agree. suggest one-line classifications and a short internal flow. keeps CS happy and eng focused.
Jo: From PM perspective: classify asks into 4 buckets: 
1) Pilot-Blocker (safety/correctness/contract break)
2) Integration-Work (API/schema or infra)
3) Config/Capacity (requires new capacity or reserved nodes)
4) UX/Docs (copy, flows, nonblocking fixes)
Connor: For internal shorthand use `PB`, `I`, `C`, `U`. Add `C` when we need procurement/infra budget.
Ava: Partners expect a decision quickly. propose: acknowledge within 24-48h, and for `PB` give ETA within 72h.
Maya: Decision: Ack within 48h for all asks; `PB` -> ETA within 72h; `I` with estimated effort <3w try to include, else backlog unless partner funds it. `C` always needs 3-week runway + finance signoff. `U` goes to backlog but we may deliver docs workaround during pilot.
Ravi: Ticketing: add `partner:PB/I/C/U` labels and `partner:sla_ack` field. also `partner:credits` if partner is offering compensation.
Jo: Compensation policy: credits only if engineering time is billed during pilot window. product+finance must approve credits.
Connor: Ops note: Capacity changes require at least 3 weeks ops lead time and scheduling to avoid impacting other tenants.
Ava: I'll draft the partner-facing blurb: short plain english: "We triage partner requests within 48 hours. Items that block the pilot will receive an ETA within 72 hours. Work that requires infrastructure or capacity may need additional lead time; we'll tell you if that applies."
Jo: Add a one-line about credits: "If we perform paid engineering work during the pilot, we may provide credit; approvals are required."
legal-bot: Reminder: any request that changes retention, logging, or access control must go to Legal before dev starts.
Maya: Action items:
- Ava: partner-facing blurb + 3-line checklist (by EOD).
- Ravi: ticket labels + PR for template (tomorrow).
- Jo: escalation matrix + owners list (Friday).
- Connor: ops runway note and capacity checklist (2 business days).
Maya: We'll trial the policy for the next 4 pilots and revisit. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ava: will post the blurb in partner intake doc.
Ravi: starting the ticket PR after lunch.
Jo: will map owners for escalation.
Connor: will share the capacity checklist with SE team.
legal-bot: Logged: legal review required flag for retention/logging/access-control.
